title: Use a guarded 320 MiB target for eligible hosted Uniform Runs
question: Can less retained capacity in the narrowly scoped chooser preserve the fixed-budget crossover and the already-external control?
summary: The guarded sorter saves 7.582–7.678 seconds in three verified pairs. Two already-external pairs add a median 0.077 seconds within the 0.6-second gate.

workloads: Explicit 1024 MiB standalone Uniform with Auto grouping and plain UTF-8, 800,000 rows.
1.1 million row external holdout with one late quoted field, plus resident, cap and cancellation cases.

validation.summary: Exact CSV, manifest, marker and cleanup check through OPFS. Competing grants check the exact 448 MiB selection edge and the first-spill transition.

limitations: Measured bundled Chromium on one host. The ledger checks share one WASI instance.
exclusions: Native, grouped and automatic sizing policy changes, renderer RSS and physical OPFS traffic.
